scope: Minimum Node/PostgreSQL/Better Auth authentication and private account workspaces

integration.approval: User explicitly approved local synthetic-account integration and reported Docker started.
integration.data: Synthetic example.test accounts retained in dedicated local test volume; no database reset or personal data.

findings: Borrowed PostgreSQL client error listener missing
Migration unlock error skipped client release
Workspace API dropped refreshed session Set-Cookie
fixes: Nested finally release; discard failed client
Return headers from session lookup and append each cookie
review.additionalHardening: Authentication 5xx responses become a fixed 503 without provider details
review.regressions: Seven targeted no-network tests included in the 30 unit tests

failuresAndDecisions.failure: Fast repeated sign-in returned 429; first bounded retry expected Retry-After but installed Better Auth returns X-Retry-After.
failuresAndDecisions.resolution: Runner accepts either response header with a positive integer <=10 seconds and retries only once. Authentication rate limits remain enabled.
